title: Rav Shmuel bar Marta
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: [Bava Batra 52a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.52a.3) records a dispute over whether Marta is a man’s or a woman’s name. [Rashbam](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashbam_on_Bava_Batra.52a.3.2) explains that Marta was Rabbi Chiyya’s brother, as in [Sanhedrin 5a](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.5a.12); [Rabbeinu Gershom](https://www.sefaria.org/Rabbeinu_Gershom_on_Bava_Batra.52a.6) takes it as a woman’s name. Hyman identifies her as Rabbi Chiyya’s sister.
And Rav Shmuel received [teachings] from Rav, as in [Pesachim 113b](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.113b.15):
Rabbah bar bar Chana transmits through Rav Shmuel bar Marta in Rav’s name.
And in [Yerushalmi Challah 1:3](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Challah.1.3.13): Rabbi Yitzchak transmits through Rav Shmuel bar Marta in Rav’s name: "Challah, they have separated" etc.
Hyman cites Megillah 15b for a teaching attributed to Rav in one version and Rav Shmuel bar Marta in another. Both attributions appear in [Megillah 16b](https://www.sefaria.org/Megillah.16b.19).
[Bava Kamma 51b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Kamma.51b.9) likewise has Rabbah bar bar Chana reporting Rav Shmuel bar Marta.
And we find Rabbi Ila, son of Rav Shmuel bar Marta, in [Berakhot 13b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.13b.21).
Rav Yitzchak bar Shmuel bar Marta, [Berakhot 25b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.25b.24).[^3][^4]

notes.text: Whether Marta is the father’s or mother’s name remains the commentators’ dispute. The heading’s title Rav is followed; the checked Pesachim passage prints Rabbi Shmuel.

The consulted Vilna Rashbam on Bava Batra 52a explains Marta as a male sage, Rabbi Chiyya’s brother. The consulted Rabbeinu Gershom says “of so-and-so’s wife,” supporting a woman’s name; that short gloss does not itself specify Chiyya’s sister. The latter relationship remains Hyman’s report. Pesachim 113b uses Rabbi Shmuel, while Hyman’s heading supplies Rav; no global title harmonization is made.

Rashbam identifies Marta as Rabbi Chiyya’s brother. Rabbeinu Gershom’s brief gloss says the items belonged to a wife, without naming her relationship to Chiyya. The linked Pesachim gives the chain through Rabbi Shmuel and Rav in the name of Rabbi Yose of Hutzal. Hyman’s abridgment ends with Rav. See [Heilprin’s corresponding entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3342&lang=en).

Megillah 16b gives Rav or, alternatively, Rav Shmuel bar Marta for the teaching about Torah study and the Temple. The next teaching names Rav Yitzchak bar Shmuel bar Marta. Compare [the following teaching](https://www.sefaria.org/Megillah.16b.20).
